mapper.insert: insert into purchase_order (order_number, status, total_amount, notes, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user) values (#{orderNumber}, #{status}, #{totalAmount}, #{notes}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser})

insert into purchase_order_item (purchase_order_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, unit_price, subtotal) values
(#{item.purchaseOrderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.subtotal})
